Tree API

class core.Tree(n_nodes: int = 0, root: int | None = None)[source]

Bases: BaseGraph

General tree structure with efficient parent-child representation.

Internal representation uses: - Parent array: O(1) parent lookup - Children lists: O(1) child access - Edge attributes: stored separately

Compatible with NetworkX, igraph, and numpy/scipy.

  • length (float) – Edge length/weight

  • **attrs (dict) – Additional edge attributes

Get all leaf nodes.

Perform depth-first search traversal.

Get depth of a node or all nodes.

Parameters:

node (int, optional) – If provided, return depth of this node. If None, return array of all node depths.

get_subtree_size(node: int | None = None) → int | ndarray[source]

Get size of subtree rooted at node (including node itself).

Parameters:

node (int, optional) – If provided, return subtree size for this node. If None, return array of all subtree sizes.

get_path_to_root(node: int) → List[int][source]

Get path from node to root.

get_path_between(node1: int, node2: int) → List[int][source]

Get path between two nodes.

Returns the unique path in the tree from node1 to node2.

get_distance(node1: int, node2: int, weighted: bool = True) → float[source]

Get distance between two nodes.

Parameters:

  • node1 (int) – Node indices

  • node2 (int) – Node indices

  • weighted (bool) – If True, use edge lengths. If False, count edges.

traverse_edges(mode: str = 'depth_first') → List[Tuple[int, int, str]][source]

Traverse edges of the tree.

Parameters:

mode (str) – ‘depth_first’: DFS traversal ‘contour’: Tree contour (edges traversed twice)

Return type:

List of (parent, child, direction) tuples where direction is ‘down’ or ‘up’

validate() → bool[source]

Validate tree structure.

Checks: - Exactly one root (node with no parent) - All other nodes have exactly one parent - No cycles - Connected

classmethod from_parent_array(parent_array: ndarray, edge_lengths: ndarray | None = None, root: int | None = None) → Tree[source]

Create tree from parent array (MATLAB-style).

Parameters:

  • parent_array (np.ndarray) – Array where parent_array[i] is the parent of node i. Root node should have parent -1 or point to itself.

  • edge_lengths (np.ndarray, optional) – Array of edge lengths. If None, all edges have length 1.

  • root (int, optional) – Root node index. If None, will be inferred.

Return type:

Tree instance

to_parent_array() → Tuple[ndarray, ndarray][source]

Export tree as parent array (MATLAB-style).

Returns:

  • parent_array (np.ndarray) – Parent array where parent_array[i] is the parent of node i

  • edge_lengths (np.ndarray) – Array of edge lengths
